deffuant.phenomenon: Opinion dynamics on an adaptive network with assimilation, repulsion, and rewiring

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the 25th percentile of pre-step agent opinions at each simulation step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Captures the lower-tail individual opinion state over time while remaining an across-agent aggregate of a micro-level primitive.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent standard deviation of pre-step opinion values.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures dispersion of individual opinions at each step, aggregating only over the agent dimension to retain a micro-level dispersion observable.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent median of pre-step opinion values.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Provides a robust location estimate for individual opinions at each step without imposing arbitrary opinion bins.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean absolute opinion distance in sampled interactions at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Summarizes the typical opinion distance in sampled interactions, a direct micro-level encounter primitive.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent standard deviation of sampled interaction opinion distances.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Tracks dispersion of interaction distances across sampled pairs, indicating variability in local encounter conditions.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of sampled interactions that satisfy the closeness condition for assimilation.

parameter_associations.rationale: A larger confidence bound permits assimilation at greater opinion distance, so the per-step fraction of accepted encounters should rise.

indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures the prevalence of assimilation-triggering local interaction events as a direct micro-level observable of the confidence criterion.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of sampled interactions that trigger repulsive updating at each step.

parameter_associations.rationale: Raising the backfire threshold makes it harder for sampled opinion distances to qualify as sufficiently distant, reducing the expected backfire fraction.

indicators.scientific_rationale: Captures the per-step prevalence of repulsion-triggering interactions as a direct micro-level observable of the backfire threshold.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of sampled interactions that produce neither assimilation nor repulsion.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures the prevalence of no-update rejection events in sampled micro-level interactions.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of sampled interactions in which the focal agent successfully replaced the sampled tie.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Quantifies how often a sampled rejected or backfire tie is successfully rewired, a local adaptive-network primitive.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean absolute signed opinion update applied at each step.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher assimilation strength increases the magnitude of opinion shifts in accepted encounters, thereby increasing the mean absolute update.

indicators.scientific_rationale: Summarizes individual update intensity as a direct micro-level observable of the assimilation strength parameter.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent standard deviation of signed opinion updates.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Captures variability in individual opinion updates and is sensitive to mixed assimilation and repulsion regimes.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of agents whose opinion update crosses zero at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures the per-step prevalence of sign-crossing elementary events, reflecting jumps in individual ideological direction.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of agents with absolute pre-step opinion at least 0.75.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Tracks the prevalence of strongly polarized individual opinion positions without using an arbitrary external grouping.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of absolute pre-step opinion values.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures average distance of individual opinions from the neutral midpoint, providing a micro-level polarization signal.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the total number of accepted sampled interactions across agents at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Counts assimilation events as a direct interaction-level volume observable, complementing the fraction-based accepted encounter indicator.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the total number of successful focal-agent tie replacements at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Counts adaptive rewiring events at the micro interaction level, complementing the rewired fraction indicator.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the standard deviation of opinions within each agent's current network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures typical within-neighborhood opinion heterogeneity using a genuine neighborhood structural operation, then summarizes across local domains.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the variance of opinions within each agent's current network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Provides a variance-based local-domain measure of opinion heterogeneity, relying on explicit network-neighborhood aggregation.

indicators.semantic_name: Mean neighborhood absolute opinion standard deviation
indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the standard deviation of absolute opinions within each agent's current network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Captures how polarized positions vary within local network neighborhoods, using a genuine neighborhood structural operation before system-wide averaging.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the variance of absolute opinions within each agent's current network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures variance in polarized positions within network-defined local domains, preserving the required meso-level structural organization.

indicators.semantic_name: Mean neighborhood interaction distance standard deviation
indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the standard deviation of sampled interaction distances within each agent's network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Uses network-defined neighborhoods to measure local dispersion of encounter distances, then summarizes across local domains.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the variance of sampled interaction distances within each agent's network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Provides a variance-based structural neighborhood measure of sampled encounter distances, retaining real local-domain organization.

indicators.semantic_name: Mean neighborhood opinion shift standard deviation
indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the standard deviation of signed opinion shifts within each agent's network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures typical heterogeneity of opinion updates inside network-defined neighborhoods, preserving the necessary meso structural reduction.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the across-agent mean of the variance of signed opinion shifts within each agent's network neighborhood.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Provides a variance-based local-domain measure of opinion update heterogeneity using explicit network-neighborhood aggregation.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the whole-system arithmetic mean of pre-step agent opinions.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Represents the collective opinion state of the entire agent population at each step, a whole-system macro observable.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the whole-system variance of pre-step agent opinions.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Measures global opinion heterogeneity across the entire system, capturing macro-level collective differentiation.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of the fraction of agents in the largest connected component of the current interaction network.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Uses the global interaction network structure to track whole-system connectivity and diffusion potential as a macro property.

indicators.scientific_definition: Time series of degree-weighted opinion assortativity across the current interaction network.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Quantifies global network-level opinion homophily as a whole-system structural macro indicator.

deffuant.interpretation_boundary: These indicators are pre-registered executable observables only. They defer all temporal-order, lagged-dependence, causal, and intervention-effect interpretation to later phases; no path, edge, prediction, statistical claim, or simulation result is asserted here.

indicators.scientific_definition: Mean occupied-neighbour same-group fraction across agents at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Local similarity is the individual exposure primitive; its cross-agent mean captures average local segmentation pressure.

indicators.semantic_name: Standard deviation of local same-group similarity
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-agent dispersion of occupied-neighbour same-group fraction at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Dispersion of local similarity measures individual heterogeneity in local group exposure.

indicators.scientific_definition: Mean occupied Moore-neighbour count across agents at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Mean neighbour count reflects local occupancy density experienced by individual agents.

indicators.scientific_definition: Proportion of agents whose local same-group fraction is below tolerance at each step, computed as the boolean dissatisfaction event fraction over agents.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher tolerance raises the minimum required same-group fraction, so more agents are classified as unsatisfied.

indicators.scientific_rationale: The unsatisfied fraction is the aggregate prevalence of the elementary dissatisfaction event.

indicators.semantic_name: Mean local similarity among unsatisfied agents
indicators.scientific_definition: Mean local same-group fraction among agents classified as unsatisfied at each step, excluding satisfied agents by boolean masking.
indicators.scientific_rationale: This observable describes the typical local context of agents currently trying to relocate.

indicators.scientific_definition: Proportion of agents that relocated during each recorded step, computed as the boolean relocation event fraction over agents.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher move_probability increases the chance an unsatisfied agent attempts relocation, raising the fraction that moves.

indicators.scientific_rationale: The moving fraction is the aggregate prevalence of the elementary relocation event.

indicators.scientific_definition: Mean periodic Manhattan distance of relocation among agents that moved during each step, excluding non-movers.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Mean move distance captures the spatial extent of individual relocation events.

indicators.scientific_definition: Mean same-group neighbour fraction at selected destinations among agents that relocated during each step, excluding non-movers.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher destination_preference increases the probability of selecting the most similar sampled vacancy, raising average destination similarity among movers.

indicators.scientific_rationale: Destination similarity measures the local exposure outcome of relocation choices.

indicators.scientific_definition: Proportion of agents with at least one occupied different-group neighbour at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Boundary exposure indicates how many individuals are directly adjacent to out-group members.

indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-agent standard deviation of destination same-group neighbour fraction, including zero for non-movers, at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Dispersion of destination similarity reflects heterogeneity in relocation outcomes.

indicators.scientific_definition: Lower quartile of agents' local same-group fraction at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Lower quartile tracks the most isolated fraction of individuals.

indicators.scientific_definition: Upper quartile of agents' local same-group fraction at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Upper quartile tracks the most grouped fraction of individuals.

indicators.scientific_definition: Shannon entropy of binned local same-group similarity across agents at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Entropy summarizes the diversity of local exposure states in the agent population.

indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-agent standard deviation of periodic Manhattan relocation distance, including zero for non-movers, at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Dispersion of move distance captures variability in relocation spatial reach.

indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-agent standard deviation of occupied Moore-neighbour count at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Dispersion of neighbour count reflects unevenness in local occupancy density.

indicators.scientific_definition: Ratio of moving agents to unsatisfied agents at each step, measuring the realized relocation response among dissatisfied agents.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher move_probability increases the chance that an unsatisfied agent attempts relocation, raising the ratio of movers to unsatisfied agents.

indicators.scientific_rationale: This interaction-level observable links the dissatisfaction event to the relocation event.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of mean local similarity
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of district-averaged local same-group similarity at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Uses fixed district membership to aggregate local similarity within districts and capture between-district segregation variation.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of unsatisfied fraction
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of district-level unsatisfied-agent fraction at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Between-district variation in dissatisfaction reveals uneven local stability pressure across public spatial districts.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of boundary-agent fraction
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of the district-level proportion of agents with at least one different-group neighbour at each step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: District-level boundary exposure variation captures local intergroup contact differences across fixed public domains.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of moving fraction
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of the district-level proportion of agents that relocated during each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Between-district variation in relocation activity indicates uneven local adjustment pressure.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of destination similarity
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of district-averaged destination same-group neighbour fraction at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Between-district dispersion of destination similarity captures local differences in relocation destination quality.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of mean neighbour count
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of district-averaged occupied Moore-neighbour count at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Between-district variation in local occupancy density identifies uneven packing across fixed spatial domains.

indicators.scientific_definition: Average district-level entropy of agent group labels within each fixed public district at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Mean district composition entropy measures within-district group mixing while using supplied district membership structure.

indicators.semantic_name: Between-district standard deviation of mean move distance
indicators.scientific_definition: Cross-district dispersion of district-averaged periodic Manhattan relocation distance at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Between-district variation in move distance captures distinct local spatial mobility patterns.

indicators.scientific_definition: Whole-system proportion of unsatisfied agents computed from the system aggregate unsatisfied count at each recorded step.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher tolerance increases the global number of unsatisfied agents, raising the whole-system unsatisfied fraction.

indicators.scientific_rationale: Whole-system dissatisfaction is a core collective outcome of the segregation process.

indicators.scientific_definition: Whole-system proportion of agents that relocated during each recorded step, computed as the ratio of relocation-event count to agent population.

parameter_associations.rationale: Higher move_probability increases the global relocation frequency, raising the whole-system moving fraction.

indicators.scientific_rationale: Global relocation fraction is a whole-system measure of aggregate adjustment intensity.

indicators.scientific_definition: Number of contiguous occupied-cell components with identical group label in the periodic grid at each recorded step, excluding vacancies.
indicators.scientific_rationale: The number of same-group contiguous components is a global structural measure of spatial sorting.

indicators.scientific_definition: Whole-grid average same-group similarity among occupied Moore neighbours at each recorded step.
indicators.scientific_rationale: Global spatial neighbour similarity is a direct whole-grid metric of segregation.

schelling.interpretation_boundary: Indicators are declarative, executable observables computed from the supplied raw fields and grammar. They do not provide statistical estimates, causal effects, temporal forecasts, or intervention contrasts; no candidate paths or predictions are asserted in this phase.
